card.name: The v. in court case names
card.fires_on: The letter "v" (versus) between two party names in a legal case citation, right after the first party's name, as in Brown v. Board of Education.

modes.label: Landmark court cases
modes.description: The "v" after the first party in a named court case, mostly US Supreme Court cases on education or civil rights.
